description:
The Bombali District Health Management Team needs to improve data quality by preventing implausible data entry. Your task is to generate min-max value boundaries for the Immunization programme in Bombali district. 

1. Navigate to the 'Data Administration' app in DHIS2 (Login: admin / district).
2. Go to 'Min-Max Value Generation'.
3. Select the immunization-related dataset (e.g., 'Expanded Programme on Immunization' or similar) and select 'Bombali' district as the organisation unit.
4. Click 'Generate' to calculate the boundaries based on historical data.
5. Verify the boundaries were generated by checking the 'Data Entry' app for a facility in Bombali (optional but recommended).
6. Create a documentation file at '/home/ga/Desktop/minmax_config_summary.txt' describing which dataset and organisation unit you configured.
